videos.title: The Pacific War: Pearl Harbor to Midway · 1941–1942 · 45-Minute Sleep Documentary
videos.description:
The first six months of the Pacific War — December 1941 to June 1942, told slowly, for sleep.

A long-form history documentary, narrated calmly, designed to be
listened to as you drift off. All visuals are HD-restored archival
footage; the narration is original.

📖 Visual source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RxcnJNnOiaw
